ev.dice_table.title: The rattle of dice
ev.dice_table.text: In the evening people have gathered by the wall to play {game}. Someone wins a handful of coins, someone curses. They make room for you: "Sit down, have a throw."
ev.dice_table.play.success: You leave the table richer. The rattle stays in your ears for a long time.
ev.dice_table.play.failure: You leave the table poorer than you sat down. "You'll win it back next time," they laugh.
ev.dice_again.title: Dice again
ev.dice_again.text: Players you know wave you over: tonight they play {game} for high stakes. You know how it goes - you start small.
ev.dice_pull.title: The pull
ev.dice_pull.text: All day you think of dice. Your hands look for your purse, your feet carry you to where they play {game}. It is hard to hold out.
ev.dice_pull.play.success: You won it back - this time.
ev.dice_pull.play.failure: Another loss. And another thought: tomorrow will be lucky.
ev.dice_refused.title: Nobody plays with you
ev.dice_refused.text: Here you are known as a lucky player - too lucky. Whenever you come near, they hide the dice: "Go play with strangers." The next town is half a day away.
ev.dice_refused.road.success: The strangers didn't know you - and left poorer.
ev.dice_refused.road.failure: Strange place, strange dice: you came back empty-handed.
ev.dice_banned.title: A cheat's fame
ev.dice_banned.text: The whole district talks about you: no town will let you sit at a table, and the watch keeps an eye on where you walk at night.
ev.dice_robbed.title: Robbers
ev.dice_robbed.text: Not only the players heard about your win. Two men wait for you in a dark alley: "The dice gave it, the dice take it back. Purse."
ev.dice_robbed.fight.success: You fought them off. The purse is still yours.
ev.dice_robbed.fight.failure: They beat you and took half the winnings.
ev.dice_robbed.run.success: You slipped away through the alleys without losing a coin.
ev.dice_robbed.run.failure: They caught you. They took almost everything.
ev.dice_unpaid.title: A gambler's debt
ev.dice_unpaid.text: The man who lost to you won't pay: "The dice were crooked, I owe you nothing." People gather round to see what you'll do.
ev.dice_unpaid.fight.failure: The fight went badly: you are hurt, and no money.
ev.dice_unpaid.court.failure: The judge only shrugged: a gambling debt is no debt.
ev.dice_accused.title: Cheat!
ev.dice_accused.text: You win too often. Someone shouts down the street that you swap the dice, and people eye you with suspicion - even those you never played.
ev.dice_accused.swear.failure: Nobody believed the oath. The name of cheat has stuck.
ev.dice_envy.title: Kin come asking
ev.dice_envy.text: {npc} heard about your win and came to borrow: "The dice brought it to you - share with your own blood."
ev.dice_creditor.title: A creditor at the gate
ev.dice_creditor.text: The man you owe from the dice table has come, with two sturdy lads. "Time's up. How will you pay?"
ev.dice_reproach.title: Reproaches
ev.dice_reproach.text: {npc} meets you in silence, then cannot hold back: "Dice again? The children eat thin gruel, and you carry money to strangers!"
ev.dice_spouse_leaves.title: Leaving
ev.dice_spouse_leaves.text: {npc} has packed a bundle: "I'm going back to my family. Live with your dice." The neighbours watch over the fence.
ev.dice_spouse_leaves.beg.success: They stayed - but made you give your word.
ev.dice_spouse_leaves.beg.failure: You could not talk them round. The house is empty.
ev.dice_ultimatum.title: Me or the dice
ev.dice_ultimatum.text: {npc} makes you choose: "Enough. Either you give up the dice - for good - or I leave."
ev.dice_old_quit.title: The hands are not what they were
ev.dice_old_quit.text: Your fingers shake, your eyes cannot see how the dice fall. The young ones at the table laugh at the old man. Perhaps enough?
diary.dice_bigwin: A big win at {game}: +{money}. People are already talking.
diary.dice_exposed: Caught your opponent cheating and took the stake: +{money}.
diary.dice_caught.fine: Caught swapping dice. A fine and shame before the whole town.
diary.dice_caught.hand: Caught swapping dice. By custom a cheat loses a hand - you were maimed.
diary.dice_caught.beating: Caught swapping dice and badly beaten.
diary.dice_caught.flog: Caught swapping dice. Flogged in public.
diary.dice_law.banned: The muhtasib caught you at dice: gambling is forbidden, you paid a fine.
diary.dice_law.seasonal: The aedile caught you at dice outside the festival - a fine.
diary.dice_lost.house: Lost the house at {game}. No home of your own now: the family rents — {home}, {rent} a month.
diary.dice_lost.land: Lost your land at {game}. Now you work someone else's.
diary.dice_lost.son: Lost your son at {game}: {who} goes into the winner's service for seven years.
diary.dice_lost.daughter: Lost your daughter at {game}: {who} is married to the winner.
diary.dice_lost.wife: Lost your wife at {game}: {who} has gone back to her kin, and everyone knows why.
diary.dice_lost.self: Lost yourself at {game}. Now you are bound to the winner.
diary.dice_legend: The family remembers: {parent} lost everything at dice. People smirk at you, and the dice call to you too.
diary.dice_relic: From {parent} you inherited the lucky dice - they say they never fail.
ev.dice_spouse_table.title: Come with me
ev.dice_spouse_table.text: {npc} is off again to where they play {game}, and calls you along: "Come with me, you'll bring me luck."
ev.dice_spouse_table.join: Go and sit at the table together
ev.dice_spouse_table.join.success: You came back together, laughing, with a full purse.
ev.dice_spouse_table.join.failure: You both lost. Neither spoke on the way home.
ev.dice_spouse_table.stop.success: {npc} stayed. The pull seems to have let go.
ev.dice_spouse_table.stop.failure: {npc} slammed the door and went to play.
ev.dice_pull.resist.success: You held out. The evening passed at home, and the pull eased a little.
ev.dice_pull.resist.failure: You stayed home, but all night you thought only of dice.
